In short — what we offer

Archi Rent is a car rental company that has been operating in Georgia since 2019. The fleet holds more than 120 vehicles, from economy class through off-road 4x4s to eight-seat minivans. We rent to tourists as well as to local companies on long-term corporate contracts.

Who rents a car in Georgia

  • Tourists — Georgia's main routes (Kazbegi, Svaneti, Kakheti, Vardzia) are hard to reach by public transport; a car cuts travel time by two to three times.
  • Business travellers — on a short visit a business-class car works out cheaper than taxis from day three onwards.
  • Companies — long-term corporate rental is an alternative to buying a fleet: no capital tied up, no maintenance administration to run.
  • Local residents — while their own car is in the workshop, for seasonal needs or for a family trip.

What sets us apart

Transparent pricing

The rate shown on the website is final. No hidden commissions, no "service fees" and no compulsory extra insurance.

Average fleet age — 4 years

Every vehicle is serviced every 8,000 km, and the full history is logged digitally.

Deposit blocked, not charged

The amount is blocked on your card and released within 3 business days of returning the car.

Roadside assistance nationwide

A 24/7 hotline; in the event of a breakdown a replacement car reaches you within 6 hours.

Our own software

We run the fleet on our own system, FleetFreak — which is why we know exactly which car frees up when, and double bookings are impossible.

Service in three languages

Georgian, English and Russian — including the rental agreement.

Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost to rent a car in Georgia per day?

An economy-class car starts at 75 GEL (roughly 28 USD) per day, a crossover at 130 GEL and an off-road 4x4 at 240 GEL. For rentals over 7 days the price drops by 10%, and from 30 days by 25%.

What documents do I need to rent a car?

An ID card or passport, a driving licence held for at least 2 years, and a credit or debit card for the deposit. Foreign nationals need an international driving permit only if their national licence is not issued in the Latin alphabet.

Can I cross the border in a rental car?

Travel to Armenia is allowed with a permit arranged in advance — 150 GEL, plus international insurance. Travel to Turkey is possible for selected categories. Travel to Azerbaijan and Russia is prohibited.

Is the mileage limited?

No. Mileage within Georgia is unlimited on every rate. For cross-border trips a daily limit of 300 km applies.

What happens in the event of an accident?

The CDW insurance included in the price covers damage above the excess (300–1,200 GEL depending on category). The excess can be waived entirely for an extra 25–45 GEL per day.

Can I return the car in a different city?

Yes. One-way rentals on the Tbilisi↔Kutaisi↔Batumi routes start at 100 GEL; other cities by arrangement.

More questions and answers are on the FAQ page.

FleetFreak — our fleet management system

We run the Archi Rent fleet on our own app, FleetFreak. The same system is available to other rental companies: bookings, conflict detection, daily P&L, per-vehicle ROI and payback period, expenses, loans and insurance all in one place. Details are on the FleetFreak page.

Booking and consultation

This site is informational — we have no online payment system. To book a car, call us or send an email; during business hours you will hear back within 15 minutes.
